model: Rule-based label audit for Seeq Formula expressions; no trained weights
registry: call shapes (function name + argument kinds) labelled 'Confirmed in Seeq docs' in the walkthroughs, with the walkthroughs that use them
rules: R2 every call shape confirmed in another walkthrough -> verified, else concept
R3 plain arithmetic -> verified unless placeholder names or decimal coefficients -> illustrative
limits: checks consistency between walkthroughs, not correctness against the Seeq Knowledge Base; R3 cannot tell a physical constant (1.013 bar) from an invented weight
